author: Bangkok_Dave
quote:
I can't put 30 FPS to the side, unfortunately. But frankly, I don't think it would change my opinion of the game. 

Let's also be clear that I'm not a GTA fan at all — but my objective score for the previous game would be a 10/10, given it was the ultimate sandbox & the stories/characters/radio & sheer depth were solid for that they. Subjectively - a different story altogether.

Feels like a modern & safe Netflix remake of a popular, gritty film. Think Pulp Fiction directed by Edgar Wright.

author: Bangkok_Dave
quote: Long time Fifa fan here... did not like any of the PES games the last few years. Played the PES 20 demo... played the FIFA 20 demo straight after & bought PES 2020. Simply incredible! Looks & feels like real football!
